facts.text: I am trying to organize my online presence.

I have been active on Twitter recently.

I want to keep track of my online activities and comments across all these platforms.
I want to make sure I am not missing any responses or notifications.
I commented on a post from an old high school friend on Facebook last Tuesday.
I congratulated my old high school friend on her new job in that Facebook comment.
I think I will use Facebook's Activity Log to keep track of my comments.
I want to export data from Facebook, like my post history or friends list.
I am curious to see my online activity over time.
